title: Grok Voice 3.0 from SpaceXSI outscores OpenAI and Google on speech-to-speech index
key_facts: SpaceXSI (formerly xAI, Elon Musk's AI company) released Grok Voice 3.0 on 14 Oct 2026, the speech-to-speech model behind its Voice Agent API.
Artificial Analysis rated it 86.9 on its Speech-to-Speech Index, ahead of OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 (83.2) and Google's Gemini 3.8 Live (82.6).
It scored 97% on Full Duplex Bench, which tests handling of pauses and interruptions.
OpenAI's model kept a narrow lead on Tau-Voice (74.5% vs 71.6%).
On ServiceNow's open-source EVA-Bench it scored 74% accuracy across more than 200 scenarios.
Priced at eight cents a minute, the same as Grok Voice 2.0.
SpaceXSI says Starlink's Grok Voice answers about 20,000 calls a day, about 70% resolved without a human; Tesla cars account for millions of Grok Voice conversations a day.
quote_evidence: Independent testing firm Artificial Analysis ranks it first among models of its type.
The OpenAI model kept a narrow lead on Tau-Voice
Roughly 70% are resolved without a human stepping in, SpaceXSI said
why_it_matters_hint: Voice agents for customer calls are a growing business, and an independent index now puts Grok ahead of OpenAI and Google on overall score.
notes: Index scores are from Artificial Analysis; call-centre and Tesla usage figures are SpaceXSI's own claims.
